nodes.name: action.yml
nodes.summary: Manually-triggered GitHub Actions workflow that checks all Markdown documentation under docs/ for broken links using the markdown-link-check action.
nodes.languageNotes: workflow_dispatch-only trigger means it runs on demand rather than automatically; config sourced from .github/workflows/mlc_config.json.

nodes.name: lint.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that enforces code formatting on every push and pull request by running the pinned psf/black formatter (v23.11.0).

nodes.name: os-test.yml
nodes.summary: Cross-platform CI workflow that runs the file-utilities test suite across a matrix of operating systems (Ubuntu, macOS Intel/ARM, Windows) and Python versions 3.10-3.12.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a strategy matrix crossing 4 OSes with 3 Python versions for broad compatibility coverage; narrowly targets syscore/tests/test_fileutils.py.

nodes.name: quick-test.yml
nodes.summary: Primary CI workflow that runs the full fast pytest suite on every push and pull request under Ubuntu with Python 3.10, emitting a JUnit XML report.

nodes.name: slow-test.yml
nodes.summary: Nightly scheduled CI workflow (cron 02:00 daily) that runs the slow/long-running pytest suite via the --runslow flag on Ubuntu with Python 3.10.
nodes.languageNotes: Cron-scheduled plus workflow_dispatch; the --runslow flag opts into tests gated behind a custom pytest marker.
